decisions.reason: Keeping a schlager compilation CD listed in a warehouse-backed 60,000-item catalog costs very little, and it remains a cheap option supporting the firm's push into broader genres even though recent results have not been observed.
A reissued jazz LP fits the label's core reissue strength and vinyl demand among collectors, so the low cost of holding the option and its continuing upside justify keeping it.
A multi-disc box set is a limited-run collector item that can sit in the catalog at low cost until stock sells through, and no evidence has shown its value will fail to materialize.
A compilation CD close to the established offer costs little to keep in stock, and with no results showing failure there is no strong reason to abandon the option yet.
